response: An HWND belongs to its creating thread; DestroyWindow cannot safely serve as finalizer-thread cleanup for a UI-owned window. The finalizer thread also does not own Spar's STA WebView/COM lifetime. Use explicit shutdown marshalled to the owning UI thread, keep callbacks and pending bridge work alive until they actually finish, then release native resources there. SparWindow.Finish already waits for pending native callbacks and bridge work before its release/destroy sequence. A close request or timeout is not proof that cleanup finished.
limitations: Read-only explanation; no code changes or native execution. None of the six focused repository skills covers general HWND ownership.
